adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff around line 1078 (in the actual code around lines 1060-1070), the code sets `destinationCalendar` conditionally: if `eventType.destinationCalendar` exists, it wraps it in an array; else if `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists, it wraps that; otherwise it's `null`. Then at line 1078 (around the `if (isTeamEventType && eventType.schedulingType === 'COLLECTIVE')` block), it does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. The issue is that when neither eventType nor organizerUser has a destinationCalendar, `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, and the optional chaining `?.push()` silently does nothing, causing team member destination calendars to be dropped. This is a real bug where collective team events would fail to create calendar events for secondary hosts when the organizer has no destination calendar configured.
